scope: Applied overall, to every required category/platform/language marginal stratum and every observed joint cell, as implemented in metrics.mjs. No approval is inferred from the instruction to finish work.
interpretation: Severe provenance/fulfillment warning precision is primary. UNKNOWN is counted separately and is not a clean verdict. Merchant/product clustering and independent evidence require review; Wilson intervals are descriptive under independence assumptions.

zeroErrorPlanningOnly.note: Even perfect observations need at least these denominators for the proposed bounds; they are not a claim that observations exist. Minimum totals, positive/negative coverage, recall, abstention and every required stratum must also pass.
